title: Build Low-Latency Multilingual Voice Agents with NVIDIA Magpie TTS: Open Weights & Full Deployment Control
summary: NVIDIA Magpie TTS is an open-weights, multilingual text-to-speech (TTS) model designed for low-latency voice agent applications. It supports 12 languages, including newly added Modern Standard Arabic, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese, with improved quality and code-switching capabilities. The model enables full deployment control, allowing enterprises to optimize latency, customize pronunciation, and maintain data privacy within their own infrastructure. Magpie achieves sub-100ms Time to First Audio (TTFA) on NVIDIA GPUs, making it suitable for real-time conversational AI applications like customer support, healthcare assistants, and enterprise copilots.
key_points: NVIDIA Magpie TTS is an open-weights model supporting 12 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Vietnamese, Mandarin, Hindi, Japanese, Modern Standard Arabic, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese.
The model is optimized for low-latency applications, achieving Time to First Audio (TTFA) as low as 32ms on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, which is critical for real-time voice interactions.
Magpie introduces architectural improvements like frame stacking and a local transformer to reduce inference time while maintaining high speech quality.
The model can be deployed on-premises or in private environments, offering full control over latency, customization, and data privacy.
Quality improvements are demonstrated through reduced character error rates (CER) and higher speaker similarity (SSIM) in languages like French and Spanish.
Magpie is part of the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent Developer Example, a reference implementation for building end-to-end voice agents with components like ASR, TTS, and LLMs.
The model supports enterprise use cases such as customer support, healthcare documentation, and multilingual translation workflows.
Open weights allow developers to fine-tune the model for domain-specific vocabulary, brand voices, or custom speaker data using NVIDIA NeMo.
NVIDIA NIM provides optimized inference containers for production deployment, ensuring scalability and performance under concurrent workloads.
